NewsArticle.Title: Guild List
NewsArticle.Content: Guild list in the view of all players currently does not display guild members. However, the guild members are still highlighted in teal on the players' list. We will display Guild members in Guild list. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
